name: Matched Audiences (website retargeting and list upload)
plain: Advertisers build ad audiences from site visitors or from uploaded email lists.
meaning: Visits on other sites and email lists are turned into ad audiences. Lists are hashed (SHA-256) in the browser or uploaded as hashes. Needs at least 300 matched members.

web.api: Campaign Manager upload; Insight Tag cookie based website audiences

access.persistence: Contact lists deleted after 30 days; audiences deleted after 90 days unless used or edited; website audience windows 30 to 180 days
steps: Advertiser uploads hashed emails or defines a website rule
Audience is used in campaigns once 300 members match

limits.headline: Can put you on an ad list after a site visit or an uploaded email
limits.user_action: Nothing. It happens when you visit a tagged site or give an email to an advertiser
can: Add visitors of tagged pages to a retargeting list
Match an uploaded list of emails to LinkedIn members
Show those people ads on LinkedIn later
cannot: Add you without a tag visit or a matching email
Show you ads if you have no LinkedIn account matching the visit
Reveal the list to the advertiser as names, only match counts
Follow you if you opt out of ad personalization in LinkedIn settings
limits.reach_label: Lists built from visits or emails

story.what_it_is: Advertisers build ad groups from people who visited their site or from lists of emails.

marketing.name: Matched Audiences
marketing.pitch: LinkedIn pitches it as a way to retarget website visitors and reach contacts from your own lists with ads.

story.for_you: You never see how you were picked. You visited a site or gave a company your email, and later you start to see its ads on LinkedIn. The company chose you from a list.
story.for_makers: Advertisers want to speak to people who already know them. Retargeting site visitors and uploading customer lists turns warm leads into ad targets. A minimum size of 300 matched members keeps small lists from singling someone out.

use_cases.example: A software firm uploads its trial users list, and shows them ads for a paid plan on LinkedIn.
A company retargets everyone who visited its pricing page in the last 30 days with a case study ad.
A sales team uploads names of target accounts and shows only those companies a custom message.
A school retargets people who read its program page, with a short video on scholarships.
A conference shows reminder ads to past attendees, matched by their email lists.
A customer list goes up as hashes, but a hash of an email can still be matched, so it is not private from LinkedIn.

risks: Your email list can be matched to you
Follow up ads you did not expect

technical_bounds: Company CSV raw file deleted after one week

linkedin.how: Follows the Insight Tag cookie for website audiences. Documented in LinkedIn Help 81195.
